title: Flipped output after a run
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $w$ be a Boolean choice word, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. Running the machine with flipped output on the configuration obtained by flipping every output bit of $c$ gives the configuration obtained by flipping every output bit of the result of running $M$ from $c$ under $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with Boolean symbols and k work tapes
